playstyle.identity: Lissandra is a control mage who can lock herself in stasis or root all enemies near a target. She excels at engaging and locking down teamfights.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive spawns a frozen thrall from dead enemies. Q fires ice shards. W roots all nearby enemies. E sends a claw you can teleport to. R can self-cast (stasis + AoE damage) or target enemy (roots them + AoE). E-R for engage, self-R to survive burst.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Lissandra spikes at level 6 with her engage/survival ultimate. Luden's and mage items scale her. She's strong at teamfight control.

passive.name: Iceborn Subjugation
passive.summary: Enemies that die near Lissandra become frozen thralls that chase enemies.
passive.details: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra, they become a frozen thrall that slows nearby enemies and eventually shatters.

abilities.name: Ice Shard
abilities.summary: Fire ice that shatters through the first enemy, slowing.
abilities.details: Lissandra throws ice that shatters through the first target, damaging and slowing enemies in a line behind them.

abilities.name: Ring of Frost
abilities.details: Lissandra freezes all nearby enemies, dealing damage and rooting them.

abilities.name: Glacial Path
abilities.summary: Send a claw of ice; reactivate to teleport to it.
abilities.details: Lissandra sends an icy claw in a direction. She can reactivate to teleport to the claw's location.

abilities.name: Frozen Tomb
abilities.summary: Self-cast for stasis and AoE damage; or target enemy to root them and deal AoE.
abilities.details: On self: Lissandra encases herself in ice (stasis), healing and dealing damage around her. On enemy: The target is rooted and takes damage; a ring of frost spreads outward.
